integrity: The analytical proof uses exact identities and classical planar theorems; standalone SymPy checking corroborates rational algebra only.
scientific_limitations: The cutoff is uniform over remaining positive parameters, not a fixed-parameter cycle criterion below threshold.
Cycle existence does not give uniqueness, orbital stability or periods.
Historical priority relative to the full Lu–Huang 2021 analysis is unresolved because its full text was inaccessible.
title: A sharp universal predator-competition cutoff for cycles in the Bazykin flow
